text: dsh-mic-input 是一款面向 DSH Web 的浏览器语音输入插件。它将麦克风按钮放入对话输入框旁，并在通用设置中提供语言、标点和自动发送选项。点击按钮即可开始听写，识别结果会实时写入草稿；手动停止后保留转写文本，也可选择自动提交。插件使用浏览器的 Web Speech API，支持跟随系统语言、中文和英语，并可自动续听、避免部分重复文本和补全句末标点。适合希望直接口述 DSH 消息的 Web 用户。使用时需浏览器支持语音识别并授予麦克风权限；无需插件 API Key。

dsh-mic-input adds speech dictation to the DSH Web composer. Click its mic button to transcribe speech into the draft. Settings control language, punctuation, and optional auto-send. It uses the browser Web Speech API; a browser support and mic permission are required. No plugin API key is needed.
想直接对着麦克风说话，把内容放进 DSH 输入框。
DSH Web 能不能把我说的话实时转成草稿？
让 DSH 支持用语音输入中文消息。
我想口述一段话，识别完自动发出去。
语音识别停顿后总是断掉，有办法接着听吗？
I want to dictate a message into the chat box instead of typing it.
Can speech recognition fill my draft live and let me submit it when I finish?
希望听写时可以选英语识别，并自动补上合适的句末标点。
dsh-mic-input 的功能「麦克风听写」：在对话输入框旁点击麦克风即可开始或停止语音识别。识别文本实时写入当前草稿，停止时保留已识别内容。
dsh-mic-input 的功能「识别语言选择」：在通用设置中选择跟随系统、中文或英语，后续语音识别会使用对应语言代码。
dsh-mic-input 的功能「标点处理」：通用设置可保留识别原样、去除标点或智能补全句末标点；提交听写草稿时按所选方式处理。
dsh-mic-input 的功能「自动发送」：开启通用设置里的自动发送后，听写停止并写入草稿时会调用输入框的提交动作；关闭时只保留文本。
dsh-mic-input 的功能「暂停后续听」：浏览器识别意外结束时插件会重新启动识别并延续当前会话；连续多次结束后则提交已有结果。
dsh-mic-input 使用浏览器 Web Speech API 处理语音，识别可能依赖浏览器所用的语音服务；使用前需允许麦克风权限。

dsh-mic-input README · dsh-mic-input：**Microphone voice input for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI — in the browser, no server, no keys.**

> 中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

A pure client plugin that adds a **microphone button** to the composer tool row of the DSH Web GUI. Click to start dictating; recognized speech is transcribed live into the input box. Everything runs in your browser through the built-in **Web Speech API**:

dsh-mic-input README · dsh-mic-input：- **Microsoft Edge** → Microsoft Azure speech service
- **Google Chrome** → Google/Chrome speech service

Zero server components, zero API keys, zero model downloads. Audio never leaves the browser (except to the browser's own speech service).

dsh-mic-input README · Features：- **Mic button** in the composer tool row (right side, next to send) — click to start/stop; red pulsing ring while listening
- **Live transcription** — interim results fill the input while you speak
- **No duplicated text** — the draft is always rebuilt from the text that was in the input when recording started, and interim echo prefixes are deduplicated (fixes the classic "重复文字" bug of Web Speech plugins)
- **Auto-continue on silence** — if the browser stops listening after a pause, the plugin silently reconnects and keeps the session (up to 6 silent ends), so long sentences are not cut off
- **Smart punctuation** (default) — auto-completes sentence-ending punctuation: `？` after 吗/呢 questions, `！` after 吧/啊/呀/哦/嘛/啦/哇/哈, `。` otherwise (English: `.`); modes: 自动补全 / 保留原样 / 去除
- **Language selection** — 跟随系统 (auto, follows browser language) / 中文 (zh-CN) / English (en-US); wrong language matching is the #1 cause of garbled recognition
- **Auto-send** — optional: submit the message automatically when dictation ends
- **Settings row** under 设置 → 通用 → 语音输入
- **Clear errors** — permission-denied / network errors show bilingual hints on the button tooltip

dsh-mic-input README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:QT-Chen/dsh-mic-input
```

or from npm (prebuilt, no build approval needed):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mic-input
```

Restart `dsh web` (or refresh the page), then click the **mic button** to the right of the input box. The first time you use it, the browser asks for microphone permission — allow it (127.0.0.1 / localhost is a secure context, so it works).
dsh-mic-input README · Install：> Note: if you installed from the GitHub source, pnpm ≥ 10 may ask you to allow the build once (`allowBuilds`). The npm install has no such step.

dsh-mic-input README · Usage tips：- Recording starts a session; **click the button again to stop and keep the transcript** in the input (auto-send only if enabled)
- If recognition produces gibberish, check the language setting — it must match what you speak (system language ≠ spoken language is the usual cause)
- Recognition quality is bounded by the browser's built-in engine; Edge (Azure) and Chrome (Google) may differ noticeably

dsh-mic-input README · Privacy：No server, no storage: audio is processed by the browser's speech service (Microsoft/Google), and only the resulting text ever enters DSH. Nothing is written to disk by this plugin.
